scientific.integrity: The closest pointwise-depth source, a polygonal floating-body source, and the later halfspace-depth/floating-body survey were materially inspected. Candidate-specific searches covered geometric and statistical aliases. The closed area formula is derived exactly from the published depth expression and checked symbolically; numerical sampling is supplementary only.
limitations: The exact pointwise halfspace-depth formula for a uniform triangle is prior work; the new content is the exact central-region area profile and its expansion.
The theorem is specific to triangles and does not provide an all-level formula for arbitrary polygons or higher-dimensional simplices.
An unindexed elementary integration of the published contours remains a historical originality risk.
The 1990 foundational paper was verified bibliographically but its full text was not materially readable in this run.

title: Exact area profile of the convex floating body of every triangle
